blocks.text: Street photography through an Australian lens – in pictures

From a sleepy restaurant to a climbing leopard, the Australian Street Photography awards celebrate the best contemporary street photos taken by Australians. Twenty-five finalists have been selected by an independent jury through Aussie Street, a platform for photographers.
The pictures celebrate ordinary public life through images of observation, chance, humour, tension, ambiguity and human connection. The exhibition is running in Sydney from November

blocks.text: michi-no-eki (government designated rest area) we had parked at to the closest metro station. Travelling by car in Japan meant we spent a lot of time traversing vacant suburban areas. The light, shadows and the hazard signage made me stop and take in the scene. I took one shot and continued into the city. When I’m out taking photos, I tend not to sit and wait for a scene to unfold. I’m happier to capture the moment as I happen to experience it.’Photograph: Luke Robinson
